title: Design System: บ้านเมล็ด · Baan Malet

display-en.purpose: Hero and section headlines on English pages, Fraunces 500.

title.purpose: Menu item names and UI titles.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, IBM Plex Sans Thai.

numeral.purpose: Italic Fraunces section numbers and story numbers.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All transforms: button lift, arrow nudge, reveals, card lift.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal (opacity + 28px rise), staggered 0.1s per item.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta pill for the main action (menu, LINE contact).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; font-family: 'Prompt', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b65a37; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-arrow { transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #b65a37; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(152,70,42,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #98462a; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined translucent pill for secondary actions on cream.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(43,29,21,0.35); background: rgba(252,249,243,0.5); color: #2b1d15; font-family: 'Prompt', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #2b1d15; background: #fcf9f3; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b65a37; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: LINE Button
components.description: Roast-black pill with the generic LINE glyph.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2b1d15; color: #f6f0e6; font-family: 'Prompt', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: #4d382a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b65a37; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-line-ico { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; background: #06c755; }

components.name: Menu Tabs
components.description: Kraft-sand pill track; selected tab is roast black.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ece3d4; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; color: #4d382a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #fcf9f3; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b65a37; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: #2b1d15; color: #f6f0e6; } .ds-count { font-size: 12px; min-width: 22px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(43,29,21,0.08); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] .ds-count { background: rgba(246,240,230,0.18); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Small terracotta-wash pill marking signature or new items.
components.html: ซิกเนเจอร์
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f1dccb; color: #98462a; font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.8; }

components.name: Review Card
components.description: Paper card with hairline border, terracotta stars and avatar initial.
components.html:
★★★★★

กาแฟหอมมาก บรรยากาศดี นั่งทำงานได้ทั้งวัน

components.css: .ds-review { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; max-width: 380px; padding: 32px; border-radius: 28px; background: #fcf9f3; border: 1px solid #ddd0bd; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-stars { color: #b65a37; letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-quote { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.7; color: #3a2a1f; } .ds-who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-who > span:last-child { display: grid; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-who strong { font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; } .ds-who small { font-size: 13px; color: #6c6057; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ece3d4; font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #7a5238; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Translucent cream sticky header with pill links and TH/EN switch.
components.html: เมนูเมล็ดกาแฟเวิร์กช็อปTHEN
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 12px; background: rgba(246,240,230,0.86); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd0bd; } .ds-nav > a { font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; color: #4d382a; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav > a:hover, .ds-nav > a[aria-current] { background: #ece3d4; color: #2b1d15; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b65a37; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; margin-left: auto; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #ddd0bd; border-radius: 999px; background: #fcf9f3; } .ds-lang a { min-width: 40px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; color: #6c6057; } .ds-lang a[aria-current] { background: #2b1d15; color: #f6f0e6; }

narrative.overview:
A warm, editorial café page that reads like a roaster's printed journal: oat-cream paper, roast-brown ink, one terracotta accent, and muted sage as the second voice. Sections are numbered like journal entries (italic Fraunces numerals with a hairline rule), headlines are large and balanced, and body copy is set generously (17px / 1.75) so Thai text breathes.

Density is low and the layout is wide: a 1440px wrap with fluid gutters, big fluid section padding, and asymmetric 7/5 and 5/7 grids. Depth comes mostly from tonal blocks (sand panels, full-bleed roast-brown and sage-forest sections) rather than shadows. Illustrations are hand-drawn inline SVG; there are no photos.

Thai and English share one system: Prompt carries Thai display and UI, IBM Plex Sans Thai carries body, and on `lang="en"` the display face switches to Fraunces with tighter leading and italic emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper surfaces, roast-brown text and dark sections, terracotta as the single action color.
Pill-shaped controls everywhere; generously rounded (28px) cards and 36px hero/workshop panels.
Numbered editorial section heads with italic serif numerals.
Tonal layering first; soft, long, low-opacity brown shadows only on floating pieces.
Mobile gets a fixed three-button quick bar (call, LINE, map) in roast black.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only action color. Sage never carries a CTA; it is a resting, decorative counter-tone.

rules.name: The Paper, Not White Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are cream or paper (#f6f0e6 / #fcf9f3). Pure #fff appears only as text on terracotta and as a hover lift.

rules.name: The Bilingual Swap Rule
rules.body: Thai display stays upright Prompt at 1.14-1.2 leading; English swaps to Fraunces with tighter leading and italic emphasis. Never set Thai in Fraunces.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat on tone. A shadow means the element sits above the page (overlap, sticky, hover, modal).

dos: Do keep terracotta (#b65a37) as the only CTA fill; use terracotta deep (#98462a) for hover and small accent text.
Do use pill shapes for every control, tab and tag, and 28px corners for cards.
Do open sections with the numbered eyebrow (italic Fraunces numeral + hairline) above a balanced headline.
Do keep grid tracks `minmax(0, 1fr)` and test at 390px.
Do draw illustrations as inline SVG using the palette above.
donts: Don't set Thai text in Fraunces; it is for English display and numerals only.
Don't put shadows on cards at rest; shadows are for floating or hovered elements.
Don't use pure white surfaces; use paper (#fcf9f3) or cream (#f6f0e6).
